title: Rhapsody
summary: A brand for an app that gathers Berlin's niche music events in one place.
intro: Rhapsody is an events app for Berlin's music scenes. The app worked, but it had never been properly branded, so I stepped back and built a brand from the ground up: audience, positioning, name, logo, colour, type and a full set of guidelines.
